result.title: Towards Universal Calibration for In-Context Classification
result.comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, 19 tables, AACL-IJCNLP Findings accepted
result.summary: In-Context Learning (ICL) has received a lot of interest recently due to its ability to improve classification accuracy for new tasks without having to fine-tune the model over these tasks. However, the impact of ICL on calibration has been far less studied. Recent work has shown that ICL can have a negative impact on calibration due to biased selection of in-context examples. The existing methods for improving ICL calibration require additional task and model-specific training, detracting from the no-fine-tuning convenience of ICL. In this work, we introduce CALIBFORMER, a universal ICL calibrator for classification tasks, that generalizes to new models and tasks without further fine-tuning on these tasks. Specifically, we design a transformer-based calibrator which uses the model predictions on in-context examples to predict a confidence score for the test input. We show that the calibrator trained on three models and ten tasks, is able to generalize/calibrate ICL predictions on several new tasks and four LLMs unseen during training. Even for frontier models like Gemini, CALIBFORMER is able to obtain over 50% reduction in calibration error.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CALIBFORMER，一个基于 transformer 的通用 ICL 校准器：用上下文示例上的模型预测来预测测试输入的置信度；在三个模型、十个任务上训练后可泛化到未见任务与四个 LLM，在 Gemini 上把校准误差降低逾 50%。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 ICL 校准，与视觉 latent 推理无直接关系；但其「读取上下文示例的预测结果、免微调地估计置信度」的思路，可能为 LVR 中答案可信度评估与停止（STOP）决策提供可核查线索。
